post_title: How many posts will Donald Trump publish on Truth Social on November 26, 2026 (ET)?

question.title: How many posts will Donald Trump publish on Truth Social on November 26, 2026 (ET)?
question.description:
Donald Trump's Truth Social account (@realDonaldTrump) is the most completely documented channel of his public communication: every post, quote post, and reblog is archived with timestamps by Trump's Truth (https://www.trumpstruth.org/), an independent archive project of Defending Democracy Together. As of November 13, 2026 the archive holds 38,974 posts dating from February 14, 2022 — an all-time average of 22.5 posts a day. Output has accelerated sharply: 6,168 posts in all of 2025 (about 18 a day); 7,906 posts in 2026 through November 11 (about 24 a day, including 1,024 in August alone); and 1,202 posts (40.1 a day) between October 15 and November 13, 2026. The busiest single day on record is November 3, 2026 (US midterm election day) with 190 posts; the busiest hour is 6 p.m. ET. Trackers that exclude reblogs and quotes report lower daily figures: TrumpAlert recorded a median of 20 posts a day from June 26 to November 8, 2026 (peak 122, on October 22), and TruthSignal reported a 27.4 average (median 20) between September 7 and November 1, 2026. Days with no posts are rare — a computational study of his 2025 posting found only four zero-post days in a 384-day sample.

The question is motivated by the politics of the Epstein files, the story that dominated the final weeks of the 2026 midterms (The Atlantic, November 6, 2026) and remains live: the Republican-led House Oversight Committee published a 136-page report on November 10, 2026 concluding that the federal government mishandled the Epstein and Maxwell investigations, and on November 11, 2026 Rep. Thomas Massie's second discharge petition gathered enough signatures to force a House floor vote on another Epstein files release bill. Trump's own posting on the subject has been episodic — e.g., his July 17, 2025 post attacking the Wall Street Journal's "FAKE letter" and his November 12–16, 2025 posts attacking the "Epstein Hoax" — and a 2026 computational study of his posting during the 2025 Epstein revelations (arXiv 2511.11532) found that surges in Epstein coverage were associated with measurable shifts in his posting behavior, testing both a "diversion" and an "always-on circus" account. Because individual references to Epstein are scattered across rallies, gaggles, and interviews, his Truth Social output is the one cleanly countable measure of how much he is saying publicly on a given day.

November 26, 2026 is Thanksgiving Day, a federal holiday with no scheduled legislative business and little competing news, and it is a day on which Trump has historically mixed holiday greetings with political messaging — his 2025 Thanksgiving salutation went up at 11:27 p.m. ET as part of a day-long series of posts on immigration restrictions. Whether the holiday quiets his account or he posts at something like his recent pace is the central judgment for forecasters.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the number of posts that the Trump's Truth archive (https://www.trumpstruth.org/search) lists for Donald Trump's Truth Social account (@realDonaldTrump) with timestamps on November 26, 2026 in America/New_York time — the timezone in which the archive records and displays all timestamps. To resolve, set that page's date-range filter to start 2026-11-26 and end 2026-11-26, display 100 results per page, and count every listed post, with original posts, quote posts, and reblogs each counting as one; for example, if 34 posts are listed for that date, the question resolves to 34. This search-listing count is the primary method and prevails if it differs from any other figure on the archive, such as the "Daily posting volume" chart at https://www.trumpstruth.org/stats. Posts that are later deleted still count if the archive lists them for that date. If the archive is unavailable or does not yet list that date at resolution time, resolution waits for it to be restored, falling back to another complete archive of the account's posts per [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions); if no count can be established, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: All timestamps are in America/New_York time: the counting window runs from 00:00 ET to 23:59 ET on November 26, 2026, so a post made at 12:30 a.m. ET on November 27 falls outside the window.
